# Indicator catalogue audit (MEAL readiness)

*Generated by `src/evaluate.py` on 15 October 2026 from `config/indicator_catalogue.yaml`. Do not edit by hand.*

Proposal measure: **share of pilot indicators with full definitions**, assessed by an indicator catalogue audit. A full definition has all 15 fields of the brief (Section 7): `code`, `name`, `definition`, `level`, `unit`, `numerator`, `denominator`, `calculation_rule`, `disaggregation`, `target_setting_rule`, `frequency`, `data_source`, `owner`, `higher_is_better`, `notes`.

The pilot programme is not chosen yet (to be confirmed with ARDE/KUBAHO), so every indicator in the catalogue is audited, with its theme.

| Result | Indicators | Share |
|---|---|---|
| All definition fields filled in | 13 of 13 | 100% |
| Fully agreed with ARDE/KUBAHO (no field still open, status no longer draft) | 0 of 13 | 0% |
| Can be calculated from the data now | 11 of 13 | 85% |

All indicators are **drafts for co-design**: the fields are written, but their owners and most targets must be agreed with ARDE/KUBAHO staff. The second figure is the one that should rise after the co-design session.
